description: Read your company profile. Campaign ideas and every email are written from it. Right after signup, website research fills it in a few minutes; poll about once a minute while researching is true.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

name: company_profile_get

businessType.description: What kind of business it is in a few words, e.g. "Roofing contractor" or "Bookkeeping firm"

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of countries it sells across. Empty for a business limited to some US states, Canadian provinces or Australian states.

description.description: What the company sells and to whom; every email and idea is written from it

researching.description: True while website research is still filling in the profile; it can only be changed once this is false

states.description: US state, Canadian province or Australian state codes it serves (TX, ON, AU-NSW), for a business limited to a region. Empty when it sells nationwide.

title: Read your company profile
